plan.notes: Source: Palomar College Program Pathways Mapper (official), Apprenticeship-Carpentry Certificate of Achievement Program pathway map, https://programmap.palomar.edu/pathway/apprenticeship-carpentry-to-career/?pt=map&year=2026, retrieved 2026-10-06. Palomar publishes the program total as a range (24–63 units); Choice/variable-unit groups transcribed at the minimum-unit option (choice:true; official ranges in choice_note). total_credits (24) is the exact sum of the minimum-unit pathway. All AA/AS/AA-T/AS-T degrees require 60 units per Palomar; maps represent one possible pathway — see a counselor for a personalized plan.
